meta.title: Add batch processing for RAG engine
meta.body_summary: Add batch processing to RAG engine by limiting unprocessed document and chunk queries, making batch size configurable, and fetching records in batches.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added batch SQL queries and configurable batch size; merged without review after 3 days with no performance evidence.

core_change_summary.description: In crates/rag-engine/src/main.rs, refactored the main RAG processing loop to fetch unprocessed documents and chunks in batches using a configurable batch size parameter. Added LIMIT and OFFSET to SQL queries in chunks.sql and documents.sql to support pagination. Added batch_size config field in config.rs.
change_trajectory: Single commit (e0abaee): added batch_size config, modified SQL queries to include LIMIT/OFFSET, and updated main processing loop to iterate in batches.
